en.headline: Open House Hong Kong returns for third edition from 28 November
en.dek: The festival of architecture and urban spaces runs until 13 December with guided tours of more than 80 buildings and specially opened sites across the city.
body: Open House Hong Kong will hold its third edition from 28 November to 13 December, offering guided tours, themed walks and talks focused on the design of the city's buildings and public spaces.

Organisers said the programme covers more than 80 unique buildings and urban spaces that are not normally open to the public, spanning residences, heritage sites, education, culture, recreation and environmental projects.

Among the sites is Kadoorie Farm and Botanic Garden, which is marking its 70th anniversary with a tour that includes heritage farm areas and the new nature conservation centre. Wah Fu Estate, designed in the 1960s, is also included as it undergoes redevelopment.
The event is presented as a way for residents to explore how architecture shapes a liveable and inclusive city. Details of specific tours and booking are available through the organisers.

zh.headline: Open House Hong Kong第三屆今日起至12月13日舉行
zh.dek: 建築與城市空間節日由11月28日至12月13日，提供超過80個建築及特別開放場地的導賞團、主題步行及講座。
body: Open House Hong Kong將於11月28日至12月13日舉辦第三屆活動，以導賞團、主題步行及講座形式，讓市民了解本港建築物及公共空間的設計故事。
主辦單位表示，節目涵蓋超過80個平常不對外開放的獨特建築及城市空間，包括住宅、教育、文物、文化創意、康樂及環境項目。
其中嘉道理農場暨植物園正慶祝70周年，導賞團會參觀文物農場遺址及新的自然保育中心。1960年代設計的華富邨亦會開放，展示其以人為本的重建。
活動旨在讓市民探索建築如何塑造宜居、包容及具韌性的城市。具體導賞及報名詳情由主辦單位公布。
